title: Article versus rule
summary: Use a language/security/project rule only where detection is mechanically reliable enough to state what was observed. Keep architecture, ownership, intent and judgement-heavy lessons in articles.
invariants: A regex does not become authoritative merely because it can match something.
Classification, detection certainty, severity and fix safety should not be conflated.
A rule states a deterministic trigger, a concrete correction and a fix-safety assessment.
No rule on the strength of intent; put intent-dependent guidance in an article/corpus.
Detection, actual violation, suggested correction and automatic rewrite safety are separate judgements.
If you cannot write a reliable trigger yet, you do not yet have a rule; you have an article.
